data: What research question from the study is the graph addressing?

The graph addresses the research question of how the performance of different models (KVRN, MANN/MD, and MANN+MD) changes with varying memory sizes for two datasets (SMTD and CamRest). The key visual elements include three lines representing the performance of each model across different memory sizes. The relationship between these elements shows that all models improve their performance as the memory size increases, but the improvement varies among the models. Specifically, MANN+MD consistently outperforms KVRN and MANN/MD across both datasets, while KVRN shows the least improvement.
